The crab-plover or crab plover (Dromas ardeola) is a bird related to the waders, but sufficiently distinctive to merit its own family Dromadidae. Its relationship within the Charadriiformes is unclear
Some species as I have notice tend to stand on one leg for sometime and they proceed further.
